strategy_roster.name: Multi-TF AI SuperTrend with ADX
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,10) > ema(close,20) and roc(close,5) > 0 and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25
strategy_roster.notes: SuperTrend bands and WMA are outside the DSL, so dual-SuperTrend alignment with price WMAs is approximated by EMA(10) above EMA(20) plus positive 5-bar momentum as a +DI/-DI proxy, gated by an ADX(14) strength filter of 25/20 (threshold not documented). The SuperTrend ATR trailing stop and the multi-timeframe combination are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: X MAN
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,20) and sma(close,20) > sma(close,50) and roc(close,10) > 0 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: Fast/slow LWMA breakouts are approximated by SMA(20)/SMA(50) since no periods are documented, the higher-timeframe momentum filter becomes a positive 10-bar ROC, and the monthly MACD confirmation is evaluated on the traded series. DistancePoints and the optional point-based take-profit/stop-loss are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Fibo Candles Trend
strategy_roster.notes: The bullish candle colour is a close inside the top 23.6% of the 10-bar high/low range, so its flip is a cross of that Fibo level. The documented 1000/2000-point stop and target are absolute point distances, not percentages, so both fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: MADH Moving Average Difference, Hann
strategy_roster.notes: Ehlers' Hann-windowed cycle estimator cannot be reproduced, so the sign of the documented short (8) versus dominant-cycle (27) moving-average difference is used directly for the long state and its reversal for the exit. No stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Simple MACD EA
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fast EMA(100) crossing the user-defined MACD level EMA translates directly, with 30 chosen as the undocumented slow length. The derived MACD Level+1 signal EMA, the point-based trailing stop with its update cap, and the adaptive wait cycles are not DSL features.

strategy_roster.name: Nasdaq Day and Night Breakdown
strategy_roster.notes: Documented as an analysis/visualisation panel with no entry, no exit and no direction, comparing Nasdaq futures and index pre-market versus regular-session differences across two symbols. The never-true guard is used rather than inventing a signal.

strategy_roster.name: Indicator Test with Conditions Table
strategy_roster.notes: A configurable condition-table testbed whose levels and comparison expressions are supplied by the operator (the only documented defaults are the > and < operators), so nothing market-derived can be derived without inventing thresholds. The never-true guard records that.

strategy_roster.name: Mawreez' RSI Divergence Detector
strategy_roster.notes: The documented lower-low / higher-RSI-low divergence becomes a 20-bar prior low with a rising one-bar RSI, exiting on the mirrored bearish divergence. The docs list only parameter names, so RSI 14 and a 20-bar minimum/maximum divergence window are stated defaults.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci Levels with High/Low Criteria AYNET
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_low_prev(low,20) and close > donchian_high(high,20) - 0.618 * (donchian_high(high,20) - donchian_low(low,20))
strategy_roster.notes: The long rule needs a close above both the previous lowest low and the Fibonacci level, here the 61.8% retracement of a 20-bar Donchian range; the level and lookback are stated defaults because the docs name no values and the higher-timeframe candle is unavailable. The mirrored high/low rule is used as the exit.

strategy_roster.name: Color
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is the luminance of a hard-coded colour (#f23645), a constant that never changes with the market, so no price-derived entry exists; it is a demo of the signal plumbing. The never-true guard is used instead of fabricating one.
